summary: Preserved the candidate's bounded consistent hashing policy, explicit-key-only spillover, strict target/implicit affinity, deterministic ring traversal, metrics, worker load lifetime tracking, non-IGW aggregate ring, and Python integration. Corrected the reviewed contract violation by making preferred_load > average_healthy_worker_load * max_load_skew the sole spill trigger and removing the extra min_load_gap configuration surface. The independently reproduced [1,0,0,0] and [2,0,0,0] counterexamples now spill deterministically to the first eligible healthy worker on the ring.

tests.command: cargo test original_contract_spills_when_relative_threshold_is_exceeded --lib -- --nocapture (exact candidate behavior, before correction)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction at loads [2,0,0,0] and max_load_skew 1.5: average healthy load was 0.5, the preferred load 2 exceeded the 0.75 bound, but candidate commit 16c841bb returned Some(0). Raw log: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-140fd4a27770/failing-before.log

18 bounded-policy/config/router tests passed, including permanent adversarial coverage for [1,0,0,0] and [2,0,0,0], below-bound affinity, deterministic spillover, one-worker safety, strict target routing, and strict implicit keys.
8 streaming and non-streaming request-lifetime load guard tests passed.
The real Router-to-two-HTTP-worker regression passed and verified key-relative clockwise spillover.
32 strict and bounded consistent-hashing related tests passed, including strict consistent hashing load invariance.
All gateway Rust targets compiled with the pinned Rust 1.90 toolchain and private target directory.

gpu_execution.evidence: The corrected defect is in CPU/Rust HTTP worker selection and was reproduced directly with deterministic worker loads. No model weights, GPU numerical path, architecture claim, throughput claim, or semantic-accuracy claim was used as evidence.

native_rebuild_evidence: Rust gateway tests and all-target checks used artifacts under /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-140fd4a27770/target. The PyO3 extension was rebuilt with maturin against /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-140fd4a27770/venv.
remaining_limitations: The active-request load signal remains local to one gateway process; spill decisions are not coordinated among multiple gateway replicas.
No model-backed GPU benchmark was run, so throughput, p95 latency, cache/prefill work, semantic accuracy, architecture-specific behavior, and distributed workload behavior remain unverified.
The gateway directory has no committed Cargo.lock; dependency resolution and build caches were kept in the private runtime.
